title: fix(ui): keep dialog tooltips above the backdrop
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fix hidden Budget and Expiry help in Enter’s API-key dialog: tooltips were portalled to the page body at z-index 50, beneath the dialog backdrop at 100.
- Portal tooltips to their nearest dialog so they share its layer; keep the existing body portal outside dialogs. Preserve tooltip appearance and copy, with no new props or dependencies.
- Verified the real key-dialog components in an isolated browser preview: light/dark, desktop/mobile, keyboard focus, hover, Escape, viewport placement, and tooltips outside dialogs. Key creation was disabled.
- Validation: UI typecheck, build, Biome, and all 48 existing UI tests pass. P02’s first focused extraction; broader UI changes stay separate.

gist.headline: Tooltips escaped the fog
gist.blurb: The Budget and Expiry hints in Enter’s API-key dialog now sit above the modal backdrop, where helpful little labels belong. Polli moved their tiny signposts into the same room as the dialog.
gist.summary: Fixed Enter’s API-key dialog so Budget and Expiry tooltips portal into their nearest dialog instead of rendering beneath the z-index 100 backdrop from the page body.
gist.impact: Users can now read and use the Budget and Expiry help tooltips in the API-key dialog on hover or keyboard focus across desktop and mobile.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy API-key settings dialog as a glowing garden shed window, with Polli wearing tiny librarian glasses placing clear Budget and Expiry signposts inside the window, safely above a soft backdrop curtain. Include small code-plants and a subtle CRT terminal to represent the UI layer fix.
